title: Earned Wage Access Agreement Holders and the Closing-Month Platform Fee of the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service
content:
**Clause.** An employer whose Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is live and went live on or before the first day of the closing month earns its tier's Earned Wage Access bundle discount figure as a percentage on the closing-month fee of its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service, one whose live agreement went live after the first day of the closing month earns that percentage divided by 2, and an employer with no live agreement earns no bundle percentage. These bundle percentages apply to the closing-month fee only, which is rounded half up to the cent; the platform fee of a completed billing month is reduced under the rule for completed billing months.

The agreement's status and its go-live date are read from the employer's Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement record; the tier is the one the disbursement service holds.

## Bundle percentage on the closing-month fee

| Tier of the disbursement service | Agreement live, went live on or before day 1 of the closing month | Agreement live, went live after day 1 of the closing month | No live agreement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Instant Pay Starter | 0 percent | 0 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Core | 50 percent | 25 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Growth | 50 percent | 25 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Pro | 25 percent | 12.5 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Scale | 25 percent | 12.5 percent | none |
| Paystride Instant Pay Enterprise | 25 percent | 12.5 percent | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A live agreement that went live on the 1st of the closing month went live on or before the first day: the full figure.
- A live agreement that went live on the 2nd of the closing month went live after the first day: the figure divided by 2.
- An agreement in any status other than live is not a live agreement: no bundle percentage.
